title: parietaria officinalis var. judaica
intro: Parietaria officinalis var. judaica, commonly known as Pellitory, is a perennial herb of the family Urticaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation and pain, as well as its ability to treat skin conditions such as eczema and dermatitis. The therapeutic actions of Pellitory include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Parietaria officinalis var. judaica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
